name: NuGet v3 with dotnet
client: NuGet bundled with .NET SDK 11.0 image; .NET 11.0 image also exercised (exact SDK versions in CI logs)
auth: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission. NuGet push uses AW_USER:AW_TOKEN as its API-key value, matching the tested native publication contract.
fresh_home: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.
prerequisites: An SDK project to pack and a separate consumer project with its PackageReference.
Use the .NET 10 image for the primary supported lane; .NET 11 is a candidate compatibility check.
Python 3 is required by the configuration snippet to encode runtime credentials safely.

configure.code:
umask 077
python3 - <<'PYCODE'
import os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root = ET.Element('configuration')
sources = ET.SubElement(root, 'packageSources')
ET.SubElement(sources, 'clear')
url = os.environ['AW_URL'] + '/artifactory/api/nuget/v3/' + os.environ['AW_REPO'] + '/index.json'
ET.SubElement(sources, 'add', key='aw', value=url)
credentials = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(root, 'packageSourceCredentials'), 'aw')
ET.SubElement(credentials, 'add', key='Username', value=os.environ['AW_USER'])
ET.SubElement(credentials, 'add', key='ClearTextPassword', value=os.environ['AW_TOKEN'])
ET.ElementTree(root).write('NuGet.Config', encoding='unicode')
PYCODE
configure.note: Generates the same NuGet.Config fields used by native acceptance, safely escaping XML. The private temporary file contains runtime credentials; never commit it. TLS verification remains enabled.

publish.note: Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

steps.code:
dotnet pack producer/Package.csproj --output nupkgs
dotnet nuget push nupkgs/Acme.Publish.1.0.0.nupkg --source aw --api-key "$AW_USER:$AW_TOKEN"
steps.note: Symbol packages are published when the project creates snupkg files. Do not log the expanded API-key argument.

install.note: Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

limitations: Use forceNugetAuthentication when the administrator requires authenticated v3 discovery.
--skip-duplicate is for an existing identical package; do not infer a general safe retry contract for changed bytes.

The catalog also registers virtual/federated classes, but this recipe only advertises classes with matching native-client evidence. Registered configuration support alone is not a native recipe qualification; remaining virtual/federated proof belongs to the follow-on phase.

contains: NuGet clients restore from a NuGet repository
A Basic user name must name the token's subject
verifies cold and warm remote packages
